_comment: Chart diagram views (menu 103) and chart styles. Run once per ChartStyle into its own directory: --ini ChartStyle=0 --out golden/jhora-chartviews (the GDI draws of every body view, slot 0 = D-1, are compared there), then --ini ChartStyle=1/2/3/4 --out golden/jhora-chartviews-style<N> (only the clipboard texts are compared). Restore ChartStyle=0 afterwards. tests/chartViewsGolden.test.ts skips while these directories are absent.
